message.reasoning_content: Need goods for future sales. Round 3 action, produce gives 2 goods. Cash tied with others; want presidency (influence) too. Small bribe 5 alashi gives influence 2, still keeps cash, plus produce unavailable though—bribe uses action. Trade-off: 2 goods worth ~ (sold_counter=6, next prices 5,4) ~9-12 alashi credit... actually selling 2 units at price 5,4*1.25 ≈ 11.25 alashi revenue. Influence 2 helps presidency and 5% bonus. But producing twice (this and later rounds) more valuable? Each round only one action. Remaining actions: rounds 3,4,5,6 = 4 actions. Produce every round gives goods. Bribe once for influence 2 secures presidency for remaining law phases (currently influence tied 1-1-1, tie_order 0 gives me presidency anyway). Actually with influence 1 and tie_order [0,2,1], I'm president already. Influence bonus 5% of bank ~1.5 alashi. Not worth losing 5 alashi cash + production. Choose produce.
